# Fortnite Download

Fortnite Download is an independent English guide for installing Fortnite from official sources.

## Main page
- [Fortnite Download](https://fortnitedownload.github.io/): platform instructions for Windows PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Android, and iPhone.
- The page includes storage planning, account safety, requirements, troubleshooting, and an FAQ.

## Source policy
Use Epic Games and official platform stores for downloads. Platform availability and requirements can change, so verify current details at the linked official source.
